reservation.role: Preserve every newly acquired episode unused and unanalyzed for a future frozen integration or independent-family audit. Acquisition and metadata only; no calendar extraction, action inspection or policy test here.
reservation.limitation: Different episodes, teams or submission IDs do not establish independent code families.

scope: All extracted episodes are exposed. Reserved actions remain unopened. Distinct teams/submissions do not prove independent code families. The latest extraction is canonical; six early v0 calendars contain the corrected itemless-PLACE parsing bug. Older hashes are retained in versions.
